card.name: Age ranges in vitamin intake tables
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and hyphens inside age ranges (such as 14 years, 4-8 years, 0-6 months) in recommended daily intake (RDA/DRI) text for vitamins. Also fires on 'per' and 'for' just after an amount per day.

modes.label: Age number
modes.description: The digits or space of an age in a list of RDA values by age group.
modes.example: for males or females ages <<1>>4 years and older; 50

modes.label: Range hyphen
modes.description: The hyphen between two ages in a child or infant age range.
modes.example: for children 1<<->>3 years-old the RDA is

modes.label: Per day wording
modes.description: Small words right after an amount, before the group it applies to.
modes.example: are 2.4 micrograms<< per>> day for adults and adolescents
